answers.text: "A shallow pullback hold is not a pivot breakout." Correct, and I never filed it as one: it is a RETRACEMENT (C2), not a breakout. RS rank and the 50/100 order are not tests in my canon. My test is a pullback inside a trend: W 9>21 HH/HL 3.15% under 20-wk high, D above EMA9 9>21 2.6% under 20-day high. The H1 tangle (ema9 93.1987 vs ema21 93.0587) is why my trigger is an hourly close above bar_high, not the hold itself.
